title: A declared relation
description: The unit this bench produces, from notes/33 section 3: one arrow, carrying the two constructs with their signatures, the sign, the declared class of forms, the scope, what it rests on, and what it deliberately does not fix. A model is a set of these plus the identity that joins them.

role.description: What the antecedent does to the consequent. No paper in the pilot corpus states one, so it is the modeller's and nothing on the page can check it.

forms.description: A CLASS and not a function: the properties the theory asserts, and the members that enumerate them. An empty properties list is the widest declaration available, not the narrowest.

expr.description: In the bench grammar, X for what the term reads

scope.description: Where it was stated to hold. `unstated` is a VALUE and not a blank: 380 of the pilot's 1080 claims state nothing, and that is a finding about the literature rather than a gap in the record.

box.description: name to [lo, hi], where a range was declared

rests_on.description: The claim ids it stands on, each tracing to a span verified verbatim against its source. Empty means the modeller posited it, which is a different warrant and is recorded as one.

not_fixed.description: What the relation deliberately leaves open, WITH THE REASON. A magnitude left open because no paper states one is a different object from one left open because the modeller has not decided.
